name: MSc Physics Laboratory - I
description: This lab course introduces the students to the experimental method in physics through a selection of hands-on experiments. It includes experiments on analog and digital electronics, certain classic experiments on the foundational aspects of physics, as well as experiments illustrating the working principles behind some advanced material characterization techniques.
